name: A Humble Task
summary: On the Red Cloud Mesa, Chief Hawkwind asks a young adventurer to check on his mother. His pressing tribal concerns keep him at Camp Narache, so he sends you southeast to the well where Greatmother Hawkwind went for water.

sections.title: Communal Harmony and Duty
sections.body: Every member of the tribe is expected to share in its harmony and do their part. For young tauren, duty begins with care for the community, not only prowess against quilboars or predators. Chief Hawkwind is bound to his post by the work of leading and defending the camp. So he trusts young adventurers to watch over the elders.

sections.title: The Well Southeast of Narache
sections.body: The wells beyond the encampment provide water for the Red Cloud Mesa. Greatmother Hawkwind left Camp Narache early in the morning to fetch fresh water from a spring southeast of the encampment. Territorial wildlife and Bristleback quilboars range across the land. When an elder is away for hours, Chief Hawkwind grows concerned and sends you to make sure she is unharmed.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind, leader of Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore, offers the task. He is in the camp's central pavilion, overseeing local affairs.
Greatmother Hawkwind is at the water well just southeast of Camp Narache, on the mesa's lower ground.

faq.q: Why doesn't Chief Hawkwind check on his mother himself?
faq.answer: Chief Hawkwind must stay at Camp Narache to oversee pressing tribal matters and guide young braves. As chieftain, he trusts the tribe to care for its own and relies on young adventurers to look after village affairs in his stead.

faq.q: Is Greatmother Hawkwind in danger at the well?
faq.answer: Aggressive mountain cougars and striders roam the surrounding plains, but Greatmother Hawkwind is safe beside the well. She is pleasantly surprised that someone went out of their way to check on an elder.

faq.q: What cultural significance does this quest carry for the tauren?
aliases: why is this a humble task
faq.answer: Tauren culture prizes family, a close community, and respect for elders. Young heroes learn that strength lies in humble service and protecting their kin, not in seeking personal glory.

faq.q: What happens after finding Greatmother Hawkwind?
aliases: what to do after finding mother
faq.answer: After you speak with Greatmother Hawkwind, she asks for further help carrying the filled water pitcher back to camp.

angles.text: For young tauren braves, answering the Chieftain's call shows respect for elders and commitment to the tribe's shared well-being, teachings of the Earth Mother.
Narache's quiet, pastoral duties show the tauren's communal way of life, set against the harsher struggle for survival found across the fledgling Horde.
